findings_addressed.oracle: The stub transport records the exact kwargs dict passed to client.chat.completions.create. The assertion checks that 'reasoning_effort' is present in that dict and equals 'medium'. This is an independent oracle: the expected tier is derived from the public threshold constant REASONING_EFFORT_MEDIUM_THRESHOLD via map_thinking_budget_to_effort, not injected by the test.
findings_addressed.documented_mutation: In src/intellicrack/providers/grok.py, change '_supports_reasoning_effort' to use '"multi-agent-xyz" in model_id' instead of '"multi-agent" in model_id'. This makes the method return False for 'grok-4-multi-agent'. _reasoning_effort_for then returns None. _dispatch_grok_create picks the branch without reasoning_effort= kwarg. The stub records the call without reasoning_effort. The assertion 'assert "reasoning_effort" in wire_kwargs' fails immediately with AssertionError.
eliminated_anti_patterns: N3: skip-masking (model-discovery skip when _supports_reasoning_effort is broken)
N8: existence/type-only check (role='assistant' and len>0 pass even with None reasoning_effort)
N3: skip-masking (AuthenticationError/RateLimitError guard converting API errors to skips)

deletions.reason: live-only test with three skip paths and assertions too weak to detect reasoning_effort routing failures; replaced by wire-parameter gate

notes: The live test G0281 had three falsifiability failures: (1) broken _supports_reasoning_effort caused model-discovery to skip rather than fail; (2) the role/content assertions passed even when reasoning_effort was omitted from the wire; (3) AuthenticationError/RateLimitError guard converted API errors into skips. The replacement TestGrokReasoningEffortWire class intercepts only the transport boundary (client.chat.completions.create) with a stub that records kwargs. All production classifiers and dispatch helpers (_supports_reasoning_effort, _reasoning_effort_for, _dispatch_grok_create) run unmodified. The primary test asserts that 'reasoning_effort' is present in the wire kwargs and equals 'medium', which fails immediately under the documented one-line mutation.
